title: Earth-baseline VLBI restores the observability of a lunar surface station in joint orbit-and-clock determination
summary: Lunar positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) is moving from concept to hardware, ESA's Moonlight/LCNS, NovaMoon reference stations, LunaNet, and Coordinated Lunar Time, all reducing to one estimation core: fix the orbits and clocks of the lunar infrastructure and tie them to an Earth/inertial frame. We ask which measurements make a surface station's absolute position observable, and prove the answer.
